pillar_reactions.evidence: Took the pillar over and extended it himself — described the 30-minute EMOM he had trained that day ('five snatches each arm, then 15 push-ups, then five thrusters each side, and then five pull-ups... I was absolutely torched'), volunteered that Trevor's approach to not training to failure every session was the concept that convinced him, and tied the outcome to the coach's own physique: 'that body, Trevor's body, it's the way I want to be built... that kind of body is my goal body.'

The strongest reaction to any pillar in the batch, and it was about the fasting element the rep raised: 'dude, I don't, I can't stress enough fasting because I think it's something so incredible. In the day that I'm fasting, I don't have low energy. I work more. The mind works very clearly... I can read like 10 articles and absorb all of them.' He had already adopted 24-36 hour fasts from Trevor's channel and said the fasting protocol, not the kettlebells, was part of what drew him in.

Rep framed it around the coming birth — 'when your second child will appear in this world, you're probably going to have less time and less sleep... here's where the accountability comes in' — and the prospect agreed ('Okay. Yeah. A lot.') but pushed back on the premise later: 'No, but I don't believe it's actually busy. I believe it's actually probably not only busy, but tiredness and lack of sleep.' Accepted the mechanism, disputed the diagnosis, and it is the pillar he engaged with least given he had already declared discipline a solved problem.

anchors.raw: when we make the conversion, the change, the conversion, it's about you're probably something along the lines of 25 to 28,000 I believe... So I don't think I can split that into payments right Now
anchors.note: The decisive anchor. USD pricing lands as roughly R$25,000-28,000, and even the discounted three-month tier is 'something close to 20,000' in his currency. He did the conversion unprompted and it is the arithmetic that stopped the sale. Second occurrence of a currency anchor in this batch after the New Zealand call, and no localised pricing exists to answer it.

anchors.raw: we already committed to a lot of expenses right now due to we moving to a different apartment... the apartment actually needs some restructuring, like infrastructure stuff... we have to have another person in our house to help us with the second child... And next year, the school for the first child, the payment goes higher.
anchors.note: Not a value objection but a fully allocated balance sheet with a known set of future claims on it — renovation, a nanny, school fees — and a practice restructure expected to reduce income for a few months. No discount addresses this; only a later start date would.

anchors.raw: it's something that I definitely look forward to do in some time because I don't think it's an absurd value. And I think for that, for Trevor's work and for the accountability, I think actually that is pretty fair
anchors.note: The only unprompted endorsement of the price anywhere in this batch, and from the prospect who most closely matches the stated ICP. Strong evidence the $6,000 number is correctly set for the intended buyer, and that this deal is a timing problem rather than a pricing one.

anchors.raw: after knowing Trevor's YouTube channel, man, I was just very excited to try the tool... I have one 16-kilogram bell, which I bought because of Trevor... I actually was attracted to Trevor's channel, not only by the kettlebells, but by the fasting protocol.
anchors.note: The free content did its job in the intended direction here, unlike the Jorge and Jared calls where it became the substitute. He has bought equipment, adopted the fasting protocol, and is executing Trevor's programming style unpaid — but instead of concluding he does not need coaching, he concluded he needs the structure. The difference appears to be that his gap is integration rather than motivation.

anchors.raw: Some of my friends and coaches that I've talked with, guys that used kettlebells in the past, but I was trying to create some knowledge in actually knowing what the tool could give me.
anchors.note: Already consults coaches informally and is used to buying expertise. No cheap substitute is anchored anywhere in this call.

unmet_demand.want: Pricing he can carry in Brazilian reais, or terms sized to a non-US income
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The offer is USD-only with no regional pricing and no FX-adjusted plan. The instalment options he was given increase the total rather than reducing the burden, which makes them the wrong instrument for this constraint. He wants to buy and cannot convert.

unmet_demand.want: A deferred start — buy now, begin after the birth in late October when training will not be impaired
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme starts when it is paid for. The rep's answer was to compress the term into the window before October instead, which inverts what the prospect asked for: he did not want less programme, he wanted it later.

unmet_demand.want: Concrete proof that kettlebell programming can be integrated with weighted calisthenics without losing strength — raised three separate times and named as his one remaining doubt
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The programme almost certainly does this, and the rep asserted it repeatedly, but nothing concrete was ever shown — no sample week, no example of how the two systems interleave, no case of another calisthenics athlete. The answer given was 'whatever you will discuss with Trevor he will build a program around that', which defers the buying question to after the purchase.

unmet_demand.want: Clarity on the results guarantee attached to the six-month tier
unmet_demand.why_unmet: The guarantee was stated once and imprecisely — roughly plus 20 lb or 10 kg on kettlebell weight from baseline — with no terms, conditions, remedy or qualifying requirements, and it appears nowhere else in this batch. Whether it exists as company policy cannot be established from this call.
